title: Synthetic Electrospun Fiber Matrix in Abdominal Wall Donor Sites for Breast Reconstruction
official: A Prospective Pilot Study of Synthetic Electrospun Fiber Matrix in Abdominal Wall Donor Sites for Breast Reconstruction
summary: This prospective single-arm pilot study will evaluate the application of meshed 5 × 7 cm Restrata® sheets to the abdominal wall donor site following deep inferior epigastric perforator (DIEP) or abdominal wall autologous free tissue transfer in 20 eligible patients.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Scheduled for DIEP or abdominal wall autologous free tissue transfer procedure.
* At least 18 years of age.
* Karnofsky performance status ≤ 80%
* Ability to understand and willingness to sign an IRB approved written informed consent document.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current smoker.
* Body mass index \> 39.9.
* Received systemic chemotherapy within 4 weeks prior to the scheduled DIEP or abdominal wall autologous free tissue transfer procedure.
* Uncontrolled diabetes mellitus determined by the investigator.

  \*Note: if there is documentation of HgbA1c \> 12% within 3 months of the scheduled DIEP or abdominal wall autologous free tissue transfer procedure, it will need to be reviewed by the PI to determine the patient's clinical situation and eligibility.
* Pregnant.
* Currently receiving any investigational agents.
* Known sensitivity to resorbable sutures (polyglactin 910, polydioxanone).
